donors.role: production-data, sandbox-paper, physical-P/Q, replay, validation, broker-reconciliation donor
donors.prohibited_shortcut: Do not copy fitted strategy thresholds or historical trade rules directly into the Alpha V2 market model.
Do not turn Beta's named debit/condor situations into Alpha V2 trading rules without independent out-of-sample P/Q valuation evidence.

rules: Every migrated donor component must retain source repository and commit provenance.
Donor code must pass SPY-DER contracts, point-in-time rules, strict CI, replay and evidence gates before promotion.
No donor's historical P&L may redefine MarketState or the physical forecast P.
Independent donor disagreement is retained as evidence rather than averaged away automatically.
